text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew, a new personal best.
At this rate...

text_block_list.name: Monologue?
text_block_list.text:
Finishing her warm-up an hour earlier than normal Umamusume,
she clocked today's time. And without a moment's rest—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, could you please not
add your own weird narration...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyaha. It's rare seeing King run on dirt.
Didn't you dislike it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just because the sand goes *p-p-p-pt*
all over your face...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's why you're running in the morning, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I trained with my Trainer around this time before, you see.
And that's when I realized something."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
An empty track is so comfortable.
No getting kicked up with dirt, no crowding.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, that's clever.
That actually might be a pretty nice idea.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Besides, they say there are countless
ways to train on just a single course!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! King is an Umamusume
who puts everything she learns to good use!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, King really is a good girl
for taking her Trainer's feelings straight to heart~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haah, what!?
Why did you summarize it like that?!

...It looks like the advice I give to King Halo
during training is really sticking with her!
